mapper.select: select ai.id, ai.title, ai.announcement_type as announcementType, ai.publish_time as publishTime, ai.publish_status as publishStatus from announcement_info ai order by ai.create_time desc
select ai.id, ai.title, ai.announcement_type as announcementType, ai.content, ai.publish_status as publishStatus from announcement_info ai where ai.id = #{announcementId}
select ai.id, ai.title, ai.publish_time as publishTime from announcement_info ai where ai.publish_status = 0 and (ai.announcement_type = 1 or ai.announcement_type = 0) order by ai.publish_time desc
select ai.id, ai.title, ai.publish_time as publishTime from announcement_info ai where ai.publish_status = 0 and (ai.announcement_type = 2 or ai.announcement_type = 0) order by ai.publish_time desc
